description: Research themes, each with the ADS bibcodes of its papers (see src/content/publications/). Theme titles approved by Matthew Payne on 2026-10-14. Every refereed paper should appear in exactly one theme or in `other`; the Research page build warns about any that do not.

themes.title: Planet formation in binaries and disks
themes.summary: Forming planets around brown dwarfs, in binary star systems and in gravitationally unstable disks.

themes.title: Exoplanet dynamics, TTVs and radial velocities
themes.summary: Resonances and stability in multi-planet systems, transit timing variations, and N-body modelling of radial-velocity data, from resonance overlap and 55 Cancri to Gliese 876 and RUN DMC.
